summary.result: Drought tolerance of P. densiflora and particularly low annual precipitation observed in 2014 were suggested as the possible reasons.
summary.background: Climate change affects plant responses on physiological characteristics and growth, and Pinus densiflora, one of the major tree species in Korea, are expected to be particularly vulnerable to rising temperature and increased precipitation.
summary.method: Precipitation was manipulated to be 30% lower or higher than the control, using transparent panels and drip irrigation.
